features.title: Vendor the methodology and notice
features.user_visible_behavior: The server ships the Cloudflare checklists, schema and validator with the MIT notice.
verification: cd tools/spec-drift && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
features.evidence: GREEN: checklists.spec.ts 3/3 (15 checklists load with source header; pages ≤ 6000 chars; unknown id refused; schema + validator vendored). pnpm typecheck OK, pnpm lint exit 0 (pre-existing warnings only in ci-templates.ts, pr-review.prompts.ts), pnpm test 232/232. THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md carries the MIT notice.
